messages:
maria: Heads up — customer reported that when rapidly switching between workspaces in the console, the Insights panel sometimes shows another workspace's saved filters and rows. Video attached. @kevin can you triage? I suspect a prefetch/routing race.

kevin: ack, I can repro by hammering quick-switch. Seems deterministic if you flip orgs fast enough. I captured a trace where the prefetch task returns panels for the previous org.

diana: any recent console quick-nav or prefetch changes rolled out? @sre-oncall do we have a deploy timeline?

deploy-bot: deploy web-console v3.14.2 by diana at 2026-03-18T21:04Z — canary -> prod.

kevin: paste of quick log snippet: ```GET /api/console/panels?org=123 -> response panels belong to org=456
ctx.orgId: 123
prefetchCacheKey: panels_456``` Looks like cache key built before org binding or we reuse a global worker pool without proper context.

maria: that matches customer screenshots — panel ids didn't belong to their org. Quick mitigation we can do: include orgId in prefetch cache key and reduce TTL, and consider disabling prefetch for quick-nav for canary.

diana: I can flip a feature flag to disable console prefetch in canary. Should we do that now?

kevin: please do. I'll open a PR with a small fix: make cache key = `panels_${orgId}_${userLocale}_${routeHash}` and add an assert that prefetch worker checks session->org. Adding a unit + integration test for the race. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/web-console/pulls/765

sre-oncall: rolling back canary now and throttling prefetch worker concurrency. Watching for any CPU / error spikes. If anything looks odd I'll page infra.

julie: I've reached out to the affected customer and told them we're investigating; they'll hold on the report until we patch. I'll offer an update after canary is stabilized.

maria: thanks all. Owner: kevin for PR, diana to flip flag + confirm deploy-bot shows new canary, julie owns comms. After merge we should run a small fuzz test: rapid org switch + prefetch enabled to confirm no cross-org panels.

kevin: ETA for PR merge ~1.5h, will post status here. Also adding an extra telemetry counter for "prefetch_org_mismatch" so we can alert if it ever happens again.

diana: flag flipped, canary prefetch disabled. Monitoring dashboards now.

sre-oncall: no new spikes, rolling back complete. Will keep an eye for perf regressions when we re-enable.

maria: excellent. Follow-ups: (1) kevin — PR and tests, (2) diana — re-enable behind flag only after tests pass, (3) julie — customer update after fix is deployed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
